customers_email_length_check.name: customers_email_length_check
customers_email_length_check.value: "app"."customers"."email" is null or char_length("app"."customers"."email") between 3 and 254

orders_confirmed_customer_check.name: orders_confirmed_customer_check
orders_confirmed_customer_check.value: "app"."orders"."status" = 'requested' or ("app"."orders"."status" = 'cancelled' and "app"."orders"."confirmed_at" is null) or "app"."orders"."customer_id" is not null

payment_records_verified_check.name: payment_records_verified_check
payment_records_verified_check.value: ("app"."payment_records"."status" = 'verified') = ("app"."payment_records"."verified_by" is not null and "app"."payment_records"."verified_at" is not null)

products_published_check.name: products_published_check
products_published_check.value: "app"."products"."status" <> 'published' or ("app"."products"."published_at" is not null and "app"."products"."category_id" is not null)

stock_reservations_dates_check.name: stock_reservations_dates_check
stock_reservations_dates_check.value: ("app"."stock_reservations"."status" = 'consumed') = ("app"."stock_reservations"."consumed_at" is not null) and ("app"."stock_reservations"."status" = 'released') = ("app"."stock_reservations"."released_at" is not null)
